issue.title: sase plan propose archives the scratch plan before publishing its links: inlet
issue.description: `sase plan propose` moves the scratch plan into the plans archive before publishing its `links:` inlet. When publication fails, the plan is archived with no approval gate and no handoff. Validate or publish the inlet first, or roll the move back on failure.

task_type_fields.impact:
Impact: an agent's plan proposal silently stops halfway. The scratch plan is gone, no approval notification is raised, and the turn does not hand off, so the agent has to discover and hand-repair the archive.

Desired remediation: validate (or publish) the `links:` inlet before consuming the scratch plan. Alternatively, roll the archive move back when inlet publication fails, so a failure leaves the scratch plan in place with a clear error. Add regression coverage with a store or inlet that fails publication.
task_type_fields.location: sase plan propose: move_plan_to_sase runs before publish_plan_artifact_link_inlet
task_type_fields.repro:
Repo: sase (external project; open it with `/sase_repo` before reading or editing). Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-5k.4 (note #2, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) during epic bob-cli-5k; triaged by bob-cli-5k.land.

Repro:
- Agent 0wk reproduced this on 2026-10-04 (sase checkout aeccf84357, recorded as a +1 on bob-cli-21). It ran `sase plan propose` on a tale plan whose frontmatter has a `links:` inlet, while the artifact-link store was invalid.
- The command crashed in `publish_plan_artifact_link_inlet` -> `load_artifact_rows` -> `assert_healthy`.
- That crash happens after `move_plan_to_sase` has already consumed the scratch file into `~/.sase/plans/YYYYMM/`, and before the pending-handoff marker is written.
- The proposal is left half-done: the plan is archived, there is no approval gate, and the runner is not handed off.
- Workaround used: move the archived file back to the scratch path, drop `links:`, and re-propose.
- The store is valid again since bob-cli-5k.4's repair, but any other inlet-publication failure (an invalid ref, a lock timeout, or a future store problem) still takes this path, because the ordering is unchanged.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-21's outage showed that a links: inlet publication failure leaves a plan proposal half-done (archived, no gate, no handoff); the epic plan asked bob-cli-5k's lander to file this sase hardening.
